requirements.provenance: GitHub artifact attestations for every selected file and the matching OCI builder
requirements.identity: Exact repository, reusable workflow commit, source commit, OIDC issuer and hosted-runner policy
requirements.isolation: Fresh hosted jobs; build has no OIDC authority; attestation job executes no build outputs
requirements.handoff: Immutable artifact IDs between build, attestation and publication
requirements.inputs: Reviewed source/tool/action/package/patch pins and inventory-bound security evidence
requirements.assessment: Actual successful run and supported GitHub build-platform guarantees must be reviewed before qualification
